articles.title: New Sun Images Reveal Whirlpools That May Power Solar Flares
articles.summary: The most detailed images of the sun ever taken show swirling plasma whirlpools on its surface. These swirls might trigger solar flares, which can disrupt technology on Earth. The discovery could help scientists predict these powerful bursts.

articles.title: Nanolaser Breakthrough Could Slash Computer Energy Use by Half
articles.summary: Researchers at DTU have created a nanolaser that could make computers faster and more energy-efficient by using light instead of electricity. Thousands could fit on a chip, potentially cutting energy use in half.

articles.title: Star Trek's 60-Year Fashion Odyssey: From Pastel Pajamas to Spandex
articles.summary: Star Trek celebrates 60 years of uniforms that have evolved from casual sweaters to tight spandex. The colors and badges tell you a crew member's job and rank, but the designs have changed with each series.
